sources.title: Kenyon Sadiq's 'dream' debut demonstrated his value to new-look Jets offense
sources.description: New York Jets first-round rookie Kenyon Sadiq had a debut to remember in the team's 23-10 win to open the 2026 season, scoring a rushing touchdown.
